logp.method_description: Lipophilicity was studied through the partition coefficient between n-octanol and phosphate buffer (0.125 M, pH 7.4). In a centrifuge tube containing 500 µL of each phase, 100 µL of the purified 99mTc complex solution was added, and the mixture was vortexed one minute at ambient temperature, followed by centrifugation at 5000 rpm for 5 min. 100 µL-aliquots of both buffer and organic layers were count using a well counter. The partition coefficient was calculated using the formula: log P = counts in n-octanol/counts in buffer. The reported value represents the average of triplicate measurements.
